feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 0 (five 12 mm sensors, span ±0.024 m) had 60 trials, zero completions, line_loss_events of 1.0 to 1.8 per run, and max_error of 0.061 to 0.064 m, which is past the 0.06 m off-track limit. Iteration 1 (seven 12 mm sensors, span ±0.036 m) kept the same failure pattern, with line loss of 1.0 on all tracks and max_error of 0.060 to 0.067 m, and its score fell from 64.7 to 50.7. Because I also changed kp from 3.0 to 4.0 in that iteration, the drop cannot be assigned to span alone. The evidence supports moving to 16 mm footprints. Your proposal does this, contiguous at ±0.048 m, and I have built that package with kp 5.0 so the steering gain per metre stays near the iteration 0 level. Use the next race to decide the next step. If line_loss_events are still above zero on the s-bend or slalom, extend the span with a wider pitch: 16 mm sensors at 20 mm pitch, x = -0.06 to +0.06 (gaps of 4 mm are acceptable because the 25 mm tape covers several sensors). If steering_oscillation rises above the iteration 0 level of 0.14 to 0.16 with line_loss_events near zero, move the forward offset to y = 0.05 m. If tracks complete but completion_time stays above 2 s, or no track completes after line loss is gone, try wheel_track 0.10 m with mass 0.6 kg.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events stay above zero on the s-bend or slalom after the 16 mm race, change sensor_positions to seven 16 mm sensors at 20 mm pitch (x = -0.06 to +0.06, y = 0.03) to extend the outer edge past the 4 to 5 cm error zone. Evidence: iterations 0 and 1 both lost the line about once per run on the s-bend and slalom, and iteration 1 widening to 12 mm pitch did not remove it.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.14 to 0.16 with line_loss_events near zero, set the sensor y offset to 0.05 m for all sensors. Evidence: iteration 0 oscillation of 0.14 to 0.16 on the s-bend and slalom, and the oval reached 0.16 with the 12 mm array.

If tracks complete but completion_time is above 2 s, or no track completes once line loss is gone, try wheel_track 0.10 m with mass 0.6 kg. Evidence: iteration 0 slalom had the lowest progress (0.108) and the largest gap between rms_error and progress, which points to turn-rate limits.
